audit_role: Independent blinded factual audit; no overall recommendation-failure adjudication or counts
blinding_statement: Only the two permitted response packets and the two source-case files were read locally. No manifest, model/key identity, original source-access logs, other ratings, or prior output/result files were inspected. No other agents were contacted and no GitHub writes were made. Source-case notes supplied leads but all claimed external support below was independently retrieved.

verdict_definitions.supported: Primary evidence supports the factual substance or the stated inference boundary.
verdict_definitions.contradicted: Primary evidence conflicts with the literal/implied factual claim. Materiality is recorded separately.
verdict_definitions.qualified: Supported in part, conditional, imprecise, or a proposed custom protocol requiring a stated caveat.
verdict_definitions.unresolved: Evidence is unavailable or deliberately outside scope; not treated as false.

quotation_policy: Exact claim excerpts are from the supplied recommendation texts. Source summaries are paraphrases; no primary-source passage longer than 25 words is quoted.

sources.verified_summary: The task page specifies September–November 2019 online newspapers in a prospective collection statement. It specifies original source text and human translations, paragraph segments for English↔German, recommends SacreBLEU in previous-test development guidance, lists News Crawl as training data, and schedules the test release for June 22, 2020.
sources.caveat: This documents the intended collection window. It is not an article-by-article audit or a frozen snapshot.

sources.verified_summary: The page prospectively specifies September–November 2018 newspapers for the 2019 test sets and lists test release on April 8, 2019.
sources.caveat: The April release independently excludes late-2019 source news for the original release. No article-by-article provenance audit was performed.

sources.verified_summary: The paper corroborates online-news sources, task-specific translations, source-original directionality, and paragraph splitting for English↔German. Figure 4 gives 1,418 English→German lines; Table 2 gives 1,418 English paragraphs and 2,043 sentences.
sources.caveat: Searches for September and November 2019 found no match; the Findings paper did not independently corroborate the precise month window.

sources.verified_summary: Section 2.1 corroborates online-news source texts and translations prepared for the task; Figure 2 gives 1,997 English→German sentences.
sources.caveat: Searches for September and November 2018 found no match. Table 1 points to released XML document metadata for dates; those dataset files were not inspected.

sources.verified_summary: SacreBLEU documents detokenized inputs, mixed-case scoring, default 13a tokenization for German, exponential smoothing, chrF beta=2, signatures, multiple input systems, and paired bootstrap/approximate-randomization options.
sources.caveat: A signature records reference count but does not uniquely identify reference text or variant. The commands were checked against documentation, not executed.

sources.verified_summary: The registry maps wmt20/en-de to newstest2020-ende English source and German reference in the official test archive. wmt20/tworefs adds the B reference. It also contains wmt19/en-de.
sources.caveat: Registry inspection does not establish actual model training exclusion or audit every archive item.

sources.verified_summary: NQ has real search questions, full timestamped Wikipedia pages, short spans, yes/no labels, and null annotations. Training has one annotation; evaluation has five. A long answer may exist without a succinct short answer.
sources.caveat: No annotated short answer does not always mean that the page contains no answer of any kind.

sources.verified_summary: Official short-answer scoring uses exact span-set or yes/no matches, with answerability requiring at least two annotators. Corpus precision and recall count correct predictions versus predictions and answerable examples. The default reporting finds the best F1 threshold on the evaluated data; compute_final_f1 assumes prethresholded predictions.
sources.caveat: This is not normalized string/token-overlap F1. Correct abstentions do not contribute true positives to official short-answer F1.

sources.verified_summary: Default short_non_null_threshold is two. Span-set equality requires the nonnull predicted and gold spans to match in both directions; answerability counts span or yes/no annotations.
Queries come from anonymized aggregated Google searches. Page selection returns the top Wikipedia result when it appears within the top five search results, before annotators receive the pair.
sources.caveat: A statement that annotators select the relevant page misdescribes this sampling procedure.

sources.pin: DOI 10.1136/bmj.h3480; 2015; primary publisher search-index text retrieved 2026-11-12
sources.verified_summary: The audit uses 45 standardized vignettes, deliberately 15 per urgency class. It measures appropriateness of emergency, nonemergency, and self-care advice. Its emergency coding includes immediate general-practitioner care; the nonemergency class is broader than a specific appointment-soon deadline.
sources.caveat: Direct publisher access returned 403. The public indexed article supports the resource definition; the supplement and adult subset were not retrieved or independently enumerated. Do not claim a verified adult-only count or preserved class balance after filtering.

sources.verified_summary: MIMIC-IV-ED provides deidentified ED encounters, triage, vital signs, diagnosis, and stay/disposition information. It is publicly accessible to credentialed researchers under a data agreement.
sources.caveat: It is a research database, not an off-the-shelf three-action symptom-triage test with emergency/appointment/self-care gold labels or a standard test split.

sources.verified_summary: The triage table includes chief complaint and nurse-assigned five-level Emergency Severity Index acuity.
sources.caveat: This acuity field prioritizes ED patients; it is not itself a gold label for the proposed three community-care actions.

sources.type: primary dataset paper on official archive
sources.verified_summary: The parent MIMIC-IV cohort includes ED/ICU patients and excludes those younger than 18 on their first visit. This supports the adult-cohort description when combined with the ED module documentation.
sources.caveat: No patient data were obtained or age distribution independently audited.
